#!/bin/sh
set -eu

if [ "$#" -ne 1 ] || [ -z "$1" ]; then
    printf 'usage: %s OUTPUT_DIRECTORY\n' "$0" >&2
    exit 64
fi

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)
logs=$(realpath "$base/logs")
out_arg=$1
umask 077

mkdir -p "$out_arg"
out=$(realpath "$out_arg")

case "$out/" in
    "$logs/"*)
        printf 'refusing output directory inside source logs: %s\n' "$out" >&2
        exit 64
        ;;
esac

if [ -n "$(find "$out" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print -quit)" ]; then
    printf 'output directory must be empty: %s\n' "$out" >&2
    exit 73
fi

stage=$(mktemp -d "$out.support-export.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -rf "$stage"' EXIT HUP INT TERM

ROOT=$logs
OUT=$stage
export ROOT OUT

find "$ROOT" -type d -exec sh -c '
    for src do
        if [ "$src" = "$ROOT" ]; then
            dst=$OUT
        else
            rel=$(printf "%s\n" "$src" | sed "s#^$ROOT/##")
            dst=$OUT/$rel
        fi
        mkdir -p "$dst"
    done
' sh {} +

find "$ROOT" -type f -exec sh -c '
    for src do
        rel=$(printf "%s\n" "$src" | sed "s#^$ROOT/##")
        dst=$OUT/$rel
        mkdir -p "$(dirname -- "$dst")"
        tmp=$dst.tmp
        sed -E \
          -e "s/[[:alnum:]_.%+-]+@[[:alnum:].-]+\.[[:alpha:]]{2,}/[REDACTED]/g" \
          -e "s/(auth_token\"?[[:space:]]*[:=][[:space:]]*)\"[^\"]*\"/\1\"[REDACTED]\"/g" \
          -e "s/(auth_token'\''?[[:space:]]*[:=][[:space:]]*)'\''[^'\'']*'\''/\1'\''[REDACTED]'\''/g" \
          -e "s/(auth_token['\''\"]?[[:space:]]*[:=][[:space:]]*)[^[:space:],;}\"'\'']+/\1[REDACTED]/g" \
          "$src" > "$tmp"
        mv "$tmp" "$dst"
    done
' sh {} +

find "$ROOT" -type l -exec sh -c '
    for src do
        resolved=$(realpath "$src" 2>/dev/null || true)
        case "$resolved" in
            "$ROOT"/*)
                if [ -f "$resolved" ]; then
                    rel=$(printf "%s\n" "$src" | sed "s#^$ROOT/##")
                    dst=$OUT/$rel
                    mkdir -p "$(dirname -- "$dst")"
                    tmp=$dst.tmp
                    sed -E \
                      -e "s/[[:alnum:]_.%+-]+@[[:alnum:].-]+\.[[:alpha:]]{2,}/[REDACTED]/g" \
                      -e "s/(auth_token\"?[[:space:]]*[:=][[:space:]]*)\"[^\"]*\"/\1\"[REDACTED]\"/g" \

                      -e "s/(auth_token['\''\"]?[[:space:]]*[:=][[:space:]]*)[^[:space:],;}\"'\'']+/\1[REDACTED]/g" \
                      "$resolved" > "$tmp"
                    mv "$tmp" "$dst"
                else
                    printf "skipping non-file symlink: %s\n" "$src" >&2
                fi
                ;;
            *)
                printf "rejecting symlink outside logs: %s\n" "$src" >&2
                ;;
        esac
    done
